summary: NMP Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 4, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with GTS Holdings, LLC and Pubco, where NMP merges into a Pubco subsidiary and GTS merges into another, leaving NMP as a Pubco subsidiary. A separate Circular will seek NMP shareholder approval, with no price, premium, or board recommendation stated in the excerpt. Upon closing, each NMP Class A share converts into one Pubco Class A share, with Class B shares and rights exchanged on a one-for-one or one-fifth basis, preserving typical SPAC redemption and overhang mechanics. Watch redemption levels, minimum-cash conditions, regulatory clearances, and any PIPE or financing terms.
